idea-plugin.name: Cupcake
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Publish as io.github.route.cupcake with a plugin icon and a preview. Uninstall the previous com.rioam2.cupcake build first; the theme selection carries over.

1.1.1

  • Give code spans in doc comments a raised purple background instead of Ruby's Darcula grey.

1.1.0

  • Recolor the IDE itself. The theme now inherits Islands Dark and swaps its palette for Cupcake's: purple-tinted surfaces, a deep purple window frame, and purple, pink, yellow and cyan accents. Requires the Islands UI (2025.3 or later).

1.0.0

  • Port the Cupcake VS Code palette to an editor color scheme built on Darcula.
idea-plugin.description:
The Cupcake palette as an editor color scheme and an Islands UI theme.

The UI inherits the bundled Islands Dark theme and only replaces its color palette, so new components added in later IDE versions pick up Cupcake colors automatically. The editor uses Cupcake's own colors: #2B2746 background, #FFFFFF text, #8175D2 comments, and the purple/pink/magenta/yellow/cyan accent set.

The scheme does not pin a font, so your global editor font, size and line spacing are left untouched.

Palette by Geoffrey, republished as rioam2/cupcake-ui. Source: github.com/route/cupcake-theme.
